messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Permitted account types for order payment",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "An order payment is only accepted for account types 'CTE', 'AHO' or 'VIR'. Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 and the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "@i_tipo_cuenta not in ('CTE', 'AHO', 'VIR')",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50001 and @o_mensaje = 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Account type is permitted\n  Given @i_tipo_cuenta is 'AHO'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then no error is raised for the account type",
   "Scenario: Account type is not permitted\n  Given @i_tipo_cuenta is 'PRE'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then @w_error is 50001 and @o_mensaje is 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Only pending orders can be paid",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment order can only be processed if its status is 'P' (pending). If the order is in any other status, it is rejected with error 50003 and the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "condition": "ord_estado of the order (ord_numero = @i_orden, ord_empresa = @i_empresa) in db_pagos..pg_orden <> 'P'",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50003 and @o_mensaje = 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Pending order passes the check\n  Given order 'ORD0000001' of company 'E01' has status 'P'\n  When the payment of the order is requested\n  Then no error 50003 is raised and processing may continue",
   "Scenario: Non-pending order is rejected\n  Given order 'ORD0000001' of company 'E01' has status 'C'\n  When the payment of the order is requested\n  Then error 50003 is set\n  And the message is 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Payment requires an existing order",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment cannot be processed for an order that does not exist. When the order lookup returns no rows, the procedure reports error 50002 with the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'.",
  "condition": "The preceding query (not shown in this slice) affected or returned zero rows (@@rowcount = 0).",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50002 and @o_mensaje = 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found\n  Given the order lookup for the payment returns no rows\n  When the payment procedure evaluates the result\n  Then the error code is 50002\n  And the message is 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
   "Scenario: Order found\n  Given the order lookup returns one row\n  When the payment procedure evaluates the result\n  Then error 50002 is not raised by this check"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Company-specific service tariff with default fallback",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The service tariff is taken from the company-specific tariff for the service, together with its 'charged separately' flag. If the company has no specific tariff, the service's default tariff applies and the commission is never charged separately ('N'). A missing tariff is treated as 0.",
  "condition": "A row exists in ad_tarifa_empresa for tar_empresa = @i_empresa and tar_servicio = @i_servicio; otherwise (@@rowcount = 0) use ad_servicio where srv_codigo = @i_servicio; if the resulting tariff is null.",
  "action": "With a company row: tariff = tar_valor and separada = tar_separada. Without one: tariff = srv_tarifa and separada = 'N'. If the tariff is still null, tariff = 0.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Company-specific tariff\n Given company 15 has a tariff of 2.00 for service 'LUZ' with separada 'S'\n When the payment is processed\n Then the tariff is 2.00 and separada is 'S'",
   "Scenario: Fallback to the service default\n Given company 15 has no tariff row for service 'AGUA' and the service default tariff is 1.50\n When the payment is processed\n Then the tariff is 1.50 and separada is 'N'",
   "Scenario: Missing tariff\n Given the tariff found is null\n When the payment is processed\n Then the tariff is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Missing tariff defaults to zero",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If no tariff value can be determined (NULL), the tariff is taken as 0, so no fee is charged.",
  "condition": "@w_tarifa is null after the lookup",
  "action": "@w_tarifa = 0",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Service without a default tariff\n Given the service has no company tariff and srv_tarifa is NULL\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the tariff is 0 and the commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Commission by channel and NOMINA exemption",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Payments made through the WEB channel pay half of the tariff as commission, rounded to 2 decimals. Other channels pay the full tariff. Service 'NOMINA' never pays a commission, whatever the channel.",
  "condition": "@i_canal = 'WEB' -> commission = round(tariff / 2, 2); otherwise commission = tariff. Then, if @i_servicio = 'NOMINA' -> commission = 0.",
  "action": "Set @w_comision as described. The NOMINA rule is applied last and overrides the channel rule.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: WEB channel discount\n Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'AGUA'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 0.63 (1.25/2 = 0.625 rounded to 2 decimals)",
   "Scenario: Other channel pays the full tariff\n Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'VEN' and the service is 'AGUA'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 1.25",
   "Scenario: NOMINA is exempt\n Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'NOMINA'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Amount debited depends on whether the commission is separate",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the tariff is marked as separate ('S'), only the order value is debited from the account. Otherwise the commission is added to the order value and both are debited together.",
  "condition": "@w_separada = 'S' -> total = @i_valor; otherwise total = @i_valor + @w_comision.",
  "action": "Set @w_total, which is the amount passed to the debit.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included in the debit\n Given the order value is 100.00, the commission is 1.25 and separada is 'N'\n When the total is calculated\n Then the total is 101.25",
   "Scenario: Separate commission\n Given the order value is 100.00, the commission is 1.25 and separada is 'S'\n When the total is calculated\n Then the total is 100.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Sufficient funds check with overdraft margin for non-VIR accounts",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' when the balance does not cover the total. Accounts of type VIR must cover the total in full. All other account types may go 100.00 below zero.",
  "condition": "(@i_tipo_cuenta = 'VIR' and saldo < total) or (@i_tipo_cuenta <> 'VIR' and saldo + 100.00 < total)",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50004 and @o_mensaje = 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: VIR account without enough balance\n Given account type 'VIR', balance 50.00, total 60.00\n When funds are validated\n Then error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' is returned",
   "Scenario: Other account within overdraft margin\n Given account type 'AHO', balance 950.00, total 1000.00\n When funds are validated\n Then no error is raised, since 950.00 + 100.00 >= 1000.00",
   "Scenario: Other account beyond overdraft margin\n Given account type 'AHO', balance 890.00, total 1000.00\n When funds are validated\n Then error 50004 is returned"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Order payment debits the account and fails on debit error",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The total amount is debited from the customer's account with the reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and the movement sequence number is returned. If the debit fails, the payment ends with error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'.",
  "condition": "db_cuentas..sp_debito returns a non-zero code or @@error <> 0.",
  "action": "Call sp_debito with the account, account type, @w_total and reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and return the sequence in @o_movimiento. On failure set @w_error = 50005 and @o_mensaje = 'ERROR EN DEBITO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given account '0012345678' with sufficient funds and a total of 101.63\n When sp_debito returns 0\n Then the movement sequence is returned in @o_movimiento",
   "Scenario: Debit rejected\n Given sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n When the payment is processed\n Then error 50005 with message 'ERROR EN DEBITO' is reported"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-010",
  "name": "Separately charged commission is debited from the payer account",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, it is debited from the payer's account with reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If that debit fails, the operation reports error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "condition": "@w_separada = 'S' and @w_comision > 0; the debit fails when sp_debito returns a value <> 0",
  "action": "Call db_cuentas..sp_debito with the account @i_cuenta, account type @i_tipo_cuenta, amount = commission and reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If the return code is not 0, set error code 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission debited separately\n Given the separate-charge flag is 'S' and the commission is 1.63\n When the payment is processed\n Then account @i_cuenta is debited 1.63 with reference 'COMISION PAGO'",
   "Scenario: Debit fails\n Given the separate-charge flag is 'S', the commission is 2.00 and sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n When the payment is processed\n Then error 50006 is set with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'",
   "Scenario: No separate debit\n Given the separate-charge flag is 'N' or the commission is 0\n When the payment is processed\n Then no commission debit is made"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-011",
  "name": "Failed commission undoes the payment",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the commission processing returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0), the open transaction is rolled back and the error is set to 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "condition": "The commission processing returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0)",
  "action": "Rollback the transaction; set error code 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION'",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission fails after successful debit\n Given the debit succeeded inside the open transaction\n When the commission step returns a non-zero code\n Then the transaction is rolled back, undoing the debit\n And the error is 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-012",
  "name": "Order payment recorded: state A, payment date and commission",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When an order is paid, it moves to state 'A', the payment date is set to the process date and the calculated commission is stored on the order.",
  "condition": "Order @i_orden of company @i_empresa in db_pagos..pg_orden (any checks in the lines not shown are unknown)",
  "action": "Set ord_estado = 'A', ord_fecha_pago = @i_fecha_proceso, ord_comision = @w_comision for ord_numero = @i_orden and ord_empresa = @i_empresa.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order is paid\n Given order 1001 of company 10 and a commission of 5.13 on process date 2024-03-15\n When the payment is applied\n Then the order has state 'A', payment date 2024-03-15 and commission 5.13"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-013",
  "name": "Payment order update must affect at least one row",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment is only treated as successful if the update of the order succeeded and touched at least one row. If the update fails or touches no rows, error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is raised. Otherwise the message 'PAGO REALIZADO' is returned.",
  "condition": "@w_error <> 0 or @w_rowcount = 0 after the order update",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50007 and @o_mensaje = 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'. When the failure branch is not taken, set @o_mensaje = 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order update affects no rows\n Given the update of the order returned @@error = 0 and @@rowcount = 0\n When the payment procedure checks the result\n Then @w_error is set to 50007\n And @o_mensaje is 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'",
   "Scenario: Order update succeeds\n Given the update of the order returned @@error = 0 and @@rowcount = 1\n When the payment procedure completes\n Then @o_mensaje is 'PAGO REALIZADO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-014",
  "name": "Order update failure or no order updated cancels the payment",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If updating the order fails, or no order row is affected, the payment is rolled back and rejected with error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'. A payment cannot succeed unless the order update took effect.",
  "condition": "@w_error <> 0 or @w_rowcount = 0 after the order update",
  "action": "Rollback the transaction; set error code 50007 and message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found when updating\n Given the debit and commission succeeded\n When the order update affects 0 rows\n Then the transaction is rolled back\n And the error is 50007 with message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-015",
  "name": "Successful payment is committed as a single unit",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "At the end of the procedure, the transaction is committed and the output message is set to 'PAGO REALIZADO'. (Preconditions and rollback behaviour must be cited from the earlier lines that perform the debit, commission and order update.)",
  "condition": "No earlier failure path was taken (debit, commission and order update all succeeded)",
  "action": "Commit the transaction; set message 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Payment completes\n Given the debit, commission and order update all succeed\n When the procedure reaches the end\n Then the transaction is committed\n And the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories": [
{
"feature": "Order payment validation",
"title": "Validate the order and account type before paying",
"narrative": "As a payments operator, I want an order payment to be accepted only for an existing pending order and a permitted account type, so that invalid or duplicate payments are stopped before any money moves.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Permitted account type is accepted\n  Given the account type is 'AHO'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then no error is raised for the account type",
"Scenario: Account type not permitted\n  Given the account type is 'PRE'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then error 50001 is returned\n  And the message is 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'",
"Scenario: Order does not exist\n  Given the order lookup for the payment returns no rows\n  When the payment is requested\n  Then error 50002 is returned\n  And the message is 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
"Scenario: Pending order may be paid\n  Given order 'ORD0000001' of company 'E01' has status 'P'\n  When the payment of the order is requested\n  Then error 50003 is not raised and processing continues",
"Scenario: Non-pending order is rejected\n  Given order 'ORD0000001' of company 'E01' has status 'C'\n  When the payment of the order is requested\n  Then error 50003 is returned\n  And the message is 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
],
"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002", "RULE-003"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Fee calculation",
"title": "Determine the service tariff for the paying company",
"narrative": "As a product owner, I want the tariff to come from the company-specific agreement or else the service default, so that each company is charged the correct fee.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Company-specific tariff is used\n  Given company 15 has a tariff of 2.00 for service 'LUZ' with separada 'S'\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then the tariff is 2.00\n  And separada is 'S'",
"Scenario: Fallback to the service default tariff\n  Given company 15 has no tariff row for service 'AGUA' and the service default tariff is 1.50\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then the tariff is 1.50\n  And separada is 'N'",
"Scenario: No tariff can be determined\n  Given company 15 has no tariff row for the service and the service default tariff is NULL\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the tariff is 0\n  And the commission is 0"
],
"links": ["RULE-004", "RULE-005"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Fee calculation",
"title": "Calculate the commission and the total to debit",
"narrative": "As a bank, I want the commission to depend on the channel and service and to be either included in or separate from the debit, so that customers are charged according to the pricing policy.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: WEB channel pays half the tariff\n  Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'AGUA'\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the commission is 0.63",
"Scenario: Other channel pays the full tariff\n  Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'VEN' and the service is 'AGUA'\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the commission is 1.25",
"Scenario: NOMINA service is exempt\n  Given the tariff is 1.25, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'NOMINA'\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the commission is 0",
"Scenario: Commission included in the debit\n  Given the order value is 100.00, the commission is 1.25 and separada is 'N'\n  When the total is calculated\n  Then the total is 101.25",
"Scenario: Commission charged separately\n  Given the order value is 100.00, the commission is 1.25 and separada is 'S'\n  When the total is calculated\n  Then the total is 100.00"
],
"links": ["RULE-006", "RULE-007"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Payment execution",
"title": "Verify sufficient funds, with overdraft margin for non-VIR accounts",
"narrative": "As a bank, I want to reject payments the account cannot cover, allowing a limited overdraft on non-VIR accounts, so that accounts do not exceed their allowed limits.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: VIR account without enough balance\n  Given account type 'VIR', balance 50.00 and total 60.00\n  When funds are validated\n  Then error 50004 is returned\n  And the message is 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
"Scenario: VIR account covers the total exactly\n  Given account type 'VIR', balance 60.00 and total 60.00\n  When funds are validated\n  Then no error is raised",
"Scenario: Other account within overdraft margin\n  Given account type 'AHO', balance 950.00 and total 1000.00\n  When funds are validated\n  Then no error is raised",
"Scenario: Other account beyond overdraft margin\n  Given account type 'AHO', balance 890.00 and total 1000.00\n  When funds are validated\n  Then error 50004 is returned\n  And the message is 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'"
],
"links": ["RULE-008"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Payment execution",
"title": "Debit the order amount from the customer account",
"narrative": "As a customer, I want the payment amount debited from my account with a traceable movement, so that my order is paid and I can see the movement.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Successful debit returns the movement sequence\n  Given account '0012345678' with sufficient funds and a total of 101.63\n  When the debit with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' is executed and sp_debito returns 0\n  Then the movement sequence is returned in @o_movimiento",
"Scenario: Debit is rejected\n  Given sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then error 50005 is returned\n  And the message is 'ERROR EN DEBITO'"
],
"links": ["RULE-009"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Payment execution",
"title": "Charge a separate commission and undo the payment if it fails",
"narrative": "As a bank, I want a separately charged commission debited from the payer's account, and the whole payment undone if that fails, so that no payment is left without its commission.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Commission debited separately\n  Given the separate-charge flag is 'S' and the commission is 1.63\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then the payer account is debited 1.63 with reference 'COMISION PAGO'",
"Scenario: No separate commission debit\n  Given the separate-charge flag is 'N' and the commission is 1.63\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then no commission debit is made",
"Scenario: Zero commission is not debited\n  Given the separate-charge flag is 'S' and the commission is 0\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then no commission debit is made",
"Scenario: Commission debit fails\n  Given the separate-charge flag is 'S', the commission is 2.00 and sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n  When the payment is processed\n  Then error 50006 is returned\n  And the message is 'ERROR EN COMISION'",
"Scenario: Failed commission rolls back the order debit\n  Given the debit of the order amount succeeded inside the open transaction\n  When the commission step returns a non-zero code\n  Then the transaction is rolled back and the debit is undone\n  And the error is 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'"
],
"links": ["RULE-010", "RULE-011"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Payment execution",
"title": "Record the payment on the order",
"narrative": "As a payments operator, I want the order marked as paid with its payment date and commission, and the payment cancelled if the order cannot be updated, so that orders and account movements stay consistent.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Order is marked as paid\n  Given order 1001 of company 10, a commission of 5.13 and process date 2024-03-15\n  When the payment is applied\n  Then the order has state 'A'\n  And the payment date is 2024-03-15\n  And the commission is 5.13",
"Scenario: Order update affects no rows\n  Given the order update returned @@error = 0 and @@rowcount = 0\n  When the payment procedure checks the result\n  Then error 50007 is returned\n  And the message is 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'",
"Scenario: Order update succeeds\n  Given the order update returned @@error = 0 and @@rowcount = 1\n  When the payment procedure checks the result\n  Then no error 50007 is raised",
"Scenario: Failed order update rolls back the payment\n  Given the debit and commission succeeded\n  When the order update affects 0 rows\n  Then the transaction is rolled back\n  And the error is 50007 with message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'"
],
"links": ["RULE-012", "RULE-013", "RULE-014"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Payment execution",
"title": "Commit a successful payment as a single unit",
"narrative": "As a customer, I want the debit, commission and order update to be confirmed together, so that a payment is either fully completed or not made at all.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Payment completes and is committed\n  Given the debit, commission and order update all succeeded\n  When the procedure reaches the end\n  Then the transaction is committed\n  And the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'"
],
"links": ["RULE-015"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 2
}
]}
